Message:
drm/amdgpu: give a fence param to ib_free

thus amdgpu_ib_free() can hook sched fence to SA manager
in later patches.

BTW:
for amdgpu_free_job(), it should only fence_put() the
fence of the last ib once, so fix it as well in this patch.
